exposure: Implementation of a national clinical practice guideline for magnesium sulfate administration
outcome: Proportion of eligible women receiving magnesium sulfate treatment
Adherence to the stipulated timeframe for magnesium sulfate administration
cohort: The study included 388 women who gave birth to live born children between 22+0 and 31+6 weeks gestational age at five Swedish university hospitals.
finding: In the first year of guideline implementation, 79% of eligible women received magnesium sulfate treatment, with the proportion increasing from 72% to 87% over the year, and 81% of those treated received the drug within the stipulated timeframe.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively for the period March 1, 2020 to February 28, 2021.
